top_choice_rationale: P001 recognises a complete, independently confirmed discovery chain: GLP-1 physiology and human insulinotropic action (Holst), receptor biology and intestinotropic actions (Drucker), and identification and synthesis of the active GLP-1(7-36) peptide (Mojsov). Therapies built on it have large randomised outcome data in glycaemia, weight, and cardiovascular and renal disease, so maturity is not in doubt. The main weakness is the contested attribution (Habener, Knudsen outside the three), but it does not justify withholding the award.
